evolution_chain.description: Original California Constitution, Declaration of Rights. Listed life, liberty, property, safety, happiness. No privacy.
Proposition 11 (Privacy Initiative) added 'and privacy' to the inalienable rights list.
Proposition 7 changed 'men' to 'people.' Text unchanged since.
